purpose: Teach: 恵比寿/坊主/生きがい/本命/クラフト/柵/ムーン/フランクフルト

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、今度、恵比寿の新しいカフェ、一緒に、行ってみない?雑誌で、特集されてたよ、本当に、素敵そうな店。
lines.en: Aoi — there's this new café in Ebisu that looked amazing in a magazine. Want to go check it out together?
lines.style: Warm opening, inviting and gentle. Light, conversational pace. She's offering something she's thought about. A small hopeful lift at the end, like she's offering a gift.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お寺の坊主さん、近所に、来てくださって、お話、本当に、深い人なのよ、葵で、いつも、勉強になるの。
lines.en: Yeah, actually — there was a temple monk who visited the neighborhood, and talking with him was really profound. I learn so much from these conversations at the café.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. She's turning inward for a moment, reflecting on something meaningful. Slower pace. A quiet certainty underneath — she's describing something that matters to her deeply.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店、本当に、葵の生きがいになってるよね、見てて、メイちゃん、嬉しいわよ、本当に、応援、ずっとしてる。
lines.en: You know, watching you with the café — it's really become your whole life, hasn't it? And I'm so glad. I'm always cheering you on.
lines.style: Tender and steady. No performance — just genuine observation. She's looking at Aoi when she says this. Warm, unhurried. The assurance of someone who means what she says.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: チョコレート、本命用の、特別なの、用意したよ、メイちゃん、彼に、渡せるかしら、本当に、楽しみだよね。
lines.en: I made something special — real chocolate, for the person who matters. I'm hoping I'll be brave enough to actually give it to him. It's so exciting.
lines.style: Bright but with a thread of vulnerability underneath. A small laugh at her own nervousness. She's building anticipation — the words move a little faster when she's excited, then slow when she doubts herself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: クラフトビールのフェア、恵比寿で、開催されてるって、聞いた、葵、行ってみたいわよね、一緒に、行こう、絶対。
lines.en: Oh, and there's a craft beer festival happening in Ebisu right now. I heard about it and thought of you. We should definitely go together.
lines.style: Animated, eager. She's connecting things in her mind and reaching out. Light, forward-moving energy. She wants to bring Aoi into her world.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お庭の柵、新しく、塗り直したよ、葵で、メイちゃん、見て、白くなって、お洒落になったよ、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: I repainted the garden fence, actually. It's white now — so much more elegant. I'm really happy with how it turned out.
lines.style: Quiet pride in small things. She's sharing something she's done, not looking for big praise. Gentle, almost understated. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ハネムーン、ハワイに、行きたいって、彼、言ってたわよ、葵、私、本当に、楽しみにしてる、絶対、行きたいね。
lines.en: He mentioned wanting to go to Hawaii for our honeymoon. And honestly, I can't wait. It's all I think about now.
lines.style: Bright, almost dreamy. She's letting herself be happy out loud. Faster, lighter pace — the words tumble a little. There's no guarding here; she's fully in it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今度、葵で、フランクフルトソーセージ、メニューに、加える予定なの、メイちゃん、ぜひ、試してみてね、本当に、美味しいよ。
lines.en: I'm adding Frankfurter sausage to the café menu soon. You have to try it when it comes out — it's really delicious.
lines.style: Warm, inviting close. She's sharing her pride in the café with someone she loves. Light, genuine. The 'you have to try it' carries both affection and real enthusiasm for the product.
